blockers.title: Unresolved, now narrowed to the map: the markers on the area map still show far numbers without '~'
blockers.evidence: Everything else in FUX-55 is fixed at a08fa95: farMark (windFormat.ts) puts the '~' on the week gust ('r~50'), the hour cells ('~24 | r ~50'), Cabinati's place rows, the map's place list ('~24 kn | r ~50'), the outing line ('Uscita 9–12:30: NW circa 24 nodi, raffiche circa 50'), the cell names and the hour announcement ('circa 24 nodi, raffica circa 50'). The markers still read '24 | 24 | 24' for Derive and '24' six times for Cabinati on Wednesday 11 AM, while the list under them reads '~24 kn' (src/features/weather/WindZoneMap.tsx:212-214 prints formatKnots(hour.mid) with no farMark). I hold this as a blocker. aria-hidden only takes the map away from screen readers. For a sighted reader the markers are the largest, most legible numbers on the map, the picture held up to a crew, and they are numbers beyond 3 days without the trend mark. The fix is one prefix, farMark(hour.lead), on the marker's number. expectMapClear (tests/e2e/weather.spec.ts) then re-checks name placement with the wider pill.
blockers.reproduction: My scratchpad's n2/r2-b.spec.ts, 'FUX-55 re-test, far Wednesday: Deriva' and '... Cabinato' (pixel-7). Clock Sat 7 Nov 09:00, open Vento, tap 'Mercoledì 11 AM', choose Mappa. Expected: the markers show '~24', like the list under them. Observed: '24'.
blockers.specRef: docs/VENTO.md:72 ('Beyond 3 days a number wears `~` and is called a trend')

importantFindings.title: Regression from the FUX-54 fix: the status text now breaks words in the middle, at every width with large text
importantFindings.evidence: `[overflow-wrap:anywhere]` on StatusLine's text column (WeatherScreen.tsx:156) lets words break anywhere. The column is narrow because the 88 px Aggiorna button and the rem-scaled padding share the row: the button's left edge is at 196 px of 320 at 200%. The layout audit's brokenWords, same results on the pixel-7 and iphone-13 viewports: 'Aggiornamento' is broken at 320, 344, 360, 390 and 412 px at 200%, and at 320/150 and 360/175. 'riuscito,' and 'riprova' are also broken at 360/200. 'potrebbero' (offline, stale copy) is broken at every 200% width up to 412, and 'superati' at 320 and 360. Cabinati's place description breaks too: 'Maddalena,' and 'Cannigione,', with each comma starting the next line (', Spargi,'). The screenshot at 320/200 shows 'Aggior / nament...'. The warning I most need to read now needs three lines and a second look. No rule in 06 forbids a broken word, so this is not a blocker. Wrapping the button below the text at large text (flex-wrap) instead of breaking words would keep both the fix and the words.

importantFindings.title: A half-day that crosses 72 hours shows a firm headline over hours marked as a trend
importantFindings.evidence: Since FUX-55, each hour cell takes its '~' from its own lead, while the headline and the week cell take theirs from the first hour's lead (summariseHours, src/domain/wind.ts:485-487). With a download at Sat 10:30, Tuesday AM reads '10kn | Raffiche 22' with no '~' in the hero and the week cell. The hour cells under the headline read '10, 10' for 9 and 10, then '~10 | r ~22' for 11, 12 and 13. The headline's gust may come from an hour beyond 72 hours and is printed without the mark. Each number follows its own rule, but in one card the trend mark comes and goes. Use the summary's reach for the hero's hours, or tell the reader.
importantFindings.specRef: docs/VENTO.md:72; lens 12 (the same concept looks the same)
